text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hey! Big news! This is, like, a huge deal!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I got double digits on my test!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: That's how hard I worked! I totes deserve a reward!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Swept along by Tosen Jordan's enthusiasm, I head out with her to an amusement park to give her both a break and a reward.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: What do you wanna ride? Should we do something scary?! What do I do if my eyelashes come off, though?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Maybe we should just get some popcorn. I'm getting amusement park overload!

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Heh, imagine getting all excited over something like this.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: What was that?!

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: I'm just saying it must be nice getting all excited over something like this. I'm not having any fun at all.

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: I mean, this is all it takes for you? A bunch of kid stuff?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Kid stuff?! Ohhh, I did not just hear that!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Now you've done it! Are you prepared to back that up?! Get over here!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hehe, so what did you think? The pirate ship was something else, right?

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: It just rocks back and forth. The scenery didn't even change.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Wh-why you little…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Th-there… How'd you like my… full-throttle teacup-spinning technique?

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: It just made me want to puke…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Yeah, same… A-anyway, what's next?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huff… Huff… See, amusement parks are totally fun!

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Hmph! Umaland is obviously way better! And it's much more popular!

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Is this place really fun for you? How can you like this at all?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: You know, it's not about if a place is, like, good or bad.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I'm here today because I earned it, so I'm jazzed no matter what kind of place it is.

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: You "earned" it?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Coming here is my prize for working hard! It's like a super special treat!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Here, why don't you try and earn something? If you can beat me at rock, paper, scissors, I'll buy you an ice cream—well, my trainer will.

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Pass… You can buy that same ice cream anywhere.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: That's not the point! Let's just do it! Rock, paper, scissooors…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Shoot! Woo, I win!

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: What?! But you changed it at the last second!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: As if! I won fair and square. What? Wanna try again?

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Bring it on!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The rock, paper, scissors battle continues until the boy manages to win.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Well?

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: …It's good.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Right? That's the taste of victory. It's sweet. It's like, you know… the feeling of earning something yourself.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: You've gotta quit being a brat and start working hard. And have fun!

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Hmph… Fine, I'll try!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Sigh… What a little punk.
choice_data_list: You were a good influence on him.
Your test scores weren't exactly anything to brag about…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: You think? Well, I do have a little sister. She's better behaved, though. I guess I'm like a pro at this whole big sister thing.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: But daycare is over! It's time to have some fun!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After that, Tosen Jordan continues to enjoy the amusement park with a big, carefree grin on her face.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: What's with the sucker punch?! You don't have to come at me like that!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Besides… I wasn't lying when I said I worked hard.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Still, I'm not gonna let you make fun of me. I'm gonna get a way better grade next time! Watch me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whatever her reasons may be, I find it endearing how she can completely throw herself into something.
